svg.title: Samba Active Directory domain controller lab architecture
svg.desc: An administrator and Windows client use an isolated Ubuntu Samba domain controller. The controller provides DNS, Kerberos, LDAP, SYSVOL, NETLOGON, and signed time, forwards non-domain queries to an upstream resolver, synchronizes with external time sources, writes a root-only local online backup, and relies on an operator to move that backup to encrypted offline storage.
